name: claude-code-fable-orchestrator
description: Fable as orchestrator, cheap models as workers. Five Claude Code subagents (scout, researcher, builder, refuter, debugger) with pinned models, two session modes (Fable as a lean orchestrator, Opus/Sonnet as a hands-on lead), a Fable-only guard hook, and a /handoff skill that keeps the main session context light. Recommended default: an Opus session with a Fable advisor.
